_comment: One place for what testers read on each build: TestFlight's What to Test (tool/testflight.py) and Play's release notes (tool/play_upload.py). Change it with the version in pubspec.yaml; a build whose version is not this one says so in its notes instead of repeating an old release's.
what_to_test: On an Android TV or Google TV, with the remote only: 1. A new TV shows Connect this screen with a QR and a code; scan it with a signed-in phone and choose Kitchen or Customer display. 2. Kitchen board: tickets sit side by side in a grid (three across on a 1080p TV), not one long list. Up, Down, Left and Right move between tickets and their Done buttons; OK presses. A long ticket says More · press OK to see all. 3. Customer display: the bill as the till rings it up; Left and Right turn the adverts; OK opens the settings behind the manager's PIN. On a phone: 4. Customers > Scan or tap their card reads a Loughor RFC member's Android phone or Wear OS watch held near the reader (NFC). 5. Buttons everywhere use the venue's lettering.
release_notes: Vesopa Go on your TV: the kitchen board lays tickets out side by side on Android TV and Google TV, and everything works with the remote. Tap a member's phone or watch to find them: Go reads the members' card by NFC.
